'''Pentecaust''' is the private-messaging and community layer of the MELEK ecosystem, published at pentecaust.com.

== Purpose ==
The Graphene social chains that preceded MELEK — [[STEEM Blockchain|STEEM]], [[HIVE Blockchain|HIVE]] and [[BLURT Blockchain|BLURT]] — never shipped a direct-messaging system. Pentecaust fills that gap and extends it into clans and cross-surface identity, so that one account carries a user across the chain, the messenger and the games.

== Function ==
* Private messages and direct conversations between accounts
* Clans, as the persistent social unit
* A single sign-in identity shared with the other ecosystem surfaces
